notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for joined-federate MOM time-state durations. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM declarations, HLAsetTiming, HLAinteger32BE, the adapter-supplied logical-time implementation, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application object/attribute names. It verifies direct and periodic HLAtimeGrantedTime/HLAtimeAdvancingTime reflection, official four-octet nonnegative duration decoding, RTI-originated metadata, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.
